title: Kirby Problem 1.37
exact_target: Construct functorial colored categorifications for every simple Lie algebra, then construct odd variants or determine what prevents them.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2696 (KP-1.37). CC BY 4.0.
